model_description: One shared, p-conditioned recurrent transition cell (470,849-parameter bidirectional 2-layer GRU + control-bit embedding + per-bit head) applied in a fixed bit-serial Horner loop with a checkpoint maximum state width of 2048 bits and a batch-local dynamic effective width. The same weights reduce a mod p, reduce b mod p (multiplicand 1), and multiply the residues (multiplicand a mod p, control bits scanning b mod p); state is carried as hard bits and the modulus is supplied through 32-bit limbs. Output is base 2 and the scorer decoder reconstructs the integer. Supported regime: p < 2^2048 and operands up to 8192 bits (tiers 1-10); outside it the model abstains and emits a single zero.
training_description: The recovered v8 lineage warm-started the L=2048 run from the L=1024 v7 cell and trained the shared transition s' = (2*s + d*x) mod p with bit-length-stratified sampling and modular-boundary oversampling. The recovered driver used BCE-with-logits, AdamW (peak lr 1.5e-3, weight decay 0.01), 2.5% warmup, cosine decay, and gradient clipping at 1.0; the selected v8 checkpoint is step 3000. Training moduli were sampled integers rather than a retained prime split, so prime-disjointness is not claimed. No precomputed tables or deterministic modular arithmetic appear in the model forward path; randomizing the weights collapses the solved tiers.
